detail.instructions: In src/domain.rs define a Score newtype wrapping u32 with a private field, a ZERO constant, new and value constructors, and a saturating AddAssign impl.

hints.body: Start with a tuple struct with a private field: pub struct Score(u32); then add the constructors.
value(self) -> u32 returns self.0; AddAssign must use self.0.saturating_add(rhs.0) so the score pins at u32::MAX instead of wrapping.
